ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.

3. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   C. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.

4. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

6. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

7. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

9. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.

10. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.

11. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

12. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Digital Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Diagrams and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.

5. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

8. A — Information and Communication Technology

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
